summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing of RoadBoss Highway Pilot Phase 2C.2 + 2C.3: Inbound SMS replies + Co-Pilot voice-to-SMS. All 22 new feature tests passed. Regression testing confirmed all 27 previous Phase 2C tests still pass. Real Twilio and SendGrid APIs working correctly.

backend_issues.notes: No backend issues found. All new endpoints working as expected. Co-Pilot voice-to-SMS successfully sends real SMS via Twilio.

frontend_issues.notes: Frontend testing not performed (backend-only testing as requested)

passed_tests: POST /api/test/sms-inbound - Admin-only simulator for inbound SMS (known driver, STOP/START keywords, HELP keyword, unknown phone, driver role 403)
POST /api/webhooks/twilio/sms-inbound - Public webhook accepts form-data, returns TwiML XML, accepts requests without signature
Audit log filtering - GET /api/notifications/logs includes sms_inbound channel, channel=sms filter excludes sms_inbound, channel=email filter excludes sms_inbound
POST /api/copilot/chat - Voice-to-SMS with 'text dispatch I am late' creates send_sms action with executed=true, provider_message_id (Twilio SID), sms_status=queued
POST /api/copilot/chat - Fuzzy matching 'text Sarah' matches Sarah Chen (fleet_admin)
POST /api/copilot/chat - Unknown recipient handled gracefully (Co-Pilot asks for clarification)
Admin phone population - super_admin@highwaypilot.io has phone +17654808889 after reseed
Alert creation - sms_reply alerts created for inbound SMS, voice_sms alerts created for Co-Pilot voice-SMS
Notification logs - sms_inbound channel logs created, copilot_voice_sms event_type logs created, driver_reply event_type logs created
STOP keyword - Sets driver.sms_opted_out=true in database
START keyword - Clears driver.sms_opted_out in database
HELP keyword - Creates warning-level alert (severity=warning)
Normal replies - Create info-level alert (severity=info)
Inbound SMS from unknown phone - Still processes, matched_driver=false, sender_name falls back to phone
Co-Pilot voice-SMS - Creates alerts row with type=voice_sms
Co-Pilot voice-SMS - Creates notification_logs row with event_type=copilot_voice_sms
Co-Pilot voice-SMS - action.recipient_role populated (super_admin/fleet_admin/dispatcher)
Co-Pilot voice-SMS - action.recipient_name populated
Twilio webhook signature validation - Accepts requests without signature (test mode)
Twilio webhook - Returns empty TwiML response (acknowledges receipt)

REGRESSION: All 27 Phase 2C tests still pass (notifications status, dispatch SMS, fleet invite, HOS warning, notification logs, password reset email, welcome email, crash alert SMS, roadside dispatch SMS, DVIR signed email, phone normalization)

success_percentage.backend: 100% (22/22 new tests passed, 27/27 regression tests passed)

features_tested: Phone matching to driver by exact phone match
Driver role gets 403 on test endpoint
phase_2c2_inbound_sms.test_results: All inbound SMS features working correctly. Webhook accepts form-data and returns proper TwiML response.
